facts.text: Amanjiwo is in the rural heartland of Central Java, surrounded by rainforest, hills and rice paddies.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by rainforest, hills and rice paddies, Amanjiwo occupies a special place in the rural heartland of Central Java.

facts.text: The resort overlooks the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Borobudur, one of Buddhism's most sacred Mahayana temples.
facts.excerpt: The resort overlooks the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Borobudur, one of Buddhism’s most sacred Mahayana temples.

facts.text: The resort lies at the foot of the Menoreh Hills and cascades down the hillside from a rotunda to a swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: the resort lies at the foot of the Menoreh Hills, cascading gracefully from a lofty rotunda down the hillside to a magnificent swimming pool.

facts.text: Amanjiwo is named 'peaceful soul' for the serenity, privacy and beauty of its setting.
facts.excerpt: named ‘peaceful soul’ for the serenity, privacy and beauty of its setting.

facts.text: Aman offers a Journey through Java by Train experience that ends with arrival at Amanjiwo after a seven-hour train journey.
facts.excerpt: After a fascinating seven-hour train journey in consummate comfort, you will arrive at Amanjiwo

facts.text: The Ancient Temples experience at Borobudur includes temple guides who explain the knowledge contained in the stone reliefs.
facts.excerpt: Temple guides will bring to life the knowledge contained within the reliefs.

facts.text: At Borobudur, as the morning mist lifts, the surrounding volcanoes and terraced fields come into view.
facts.excerpt: the mist slowly lifts, unveiling the surrounding volcanoes and terraced fields.

facts.text: Amanjiwo is placed for exploring the region's historic, artistic and cultural highlights.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly placed for exploring the region’s historic, artistic and cultural highlights, or for simply relaxing in blissful surroundings

facts.text: Guests can combine stays at Aman's four Indonesian resorts and choose exclusive experiences at each.
facts.excerpt: Combine stays at any of Aman’s four Indonesian resorts and choose from exclusive experiences at each.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Amanjiwo at Jalan Salaman-mungkid, Magelang, Java.
